summary: Six games were played on Saturday, and home teams won all of them. Victor Wembanyama scored 50 points in San Antonio's 114-91 win over New Orleans, and Tyler Herro scored 50 in Milwaukee's 132-129 loss at Philadelphia. Mikal Bridges' three-pointer at the buzzer gave New York a 97-96 win over Portland, and Keegan Murray's tip-in with five seconds left lifted Sacramento past Boston by the same score.

games.headline: 76ers survive Tyler Herro's 50 points
games.story: Tyler Herro scored 50 points on 15-of-23 shooting, including 13-of-13 at the line, with 11 rebounds and seven assists, but Milwaukee lost. Philadelphia went ahead for good at 71-70 in the third quarter and pulled away with 12 straight points to lead 86-73. Brayden Burries' three-pointer cut it to 130-129 with six seconds left, and Joel Embiid made two free throws with 1.5 seconds remaining to close it out. Embiid finished with 26 points, 17 rebounds and nine assists, and LeBron James added 21 points, six rebounds and six assists.

games.headline: Bridges beats the buzzer as Knicks edge Blazers
games.story: New York scored 40 points in the first quarter and led by 26 late in the half, but Portland outscored the Knicks 53-31 after halftime. Trailing 94-84 with about five minutes left, the Blazers scored the next 12 points, and Deni Avdija's two free throws put them ahead 96-94 with three seconds to go. Mikal Bridges answered with a step-back three-pointer at the buzzer. Jalen Brunson scored 30 for the Knicks, who were without Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby, and Donovan Clingan had 22 points and 13 rebounds for Portland.

games.headline: Mavericks pull away from Clippers with late 11-0 run
games.story: Dallas trailed 33-24 early in the second quarter, answered with 13 straight points and led 52-44 at halftime. The Clippers cut the lead to one point early in the fourth, but the Mavericks broke open a 91-88 game with 11 straight points. Kyrie Irving scored 25 points and Cooper Flagg had 22 points, eight assists and six rebounds. Brook Lopez led Los Angeles with 21 points and Rui Hachimura added 19.

games.headline: McDaniels scores 25 as Wolves hold off Grizzlies
games.story: Memphis scored 34 points in the first quarter and led by 11, but managed only 12 in the second as Minnesota went ahead for good late in the quarter and led 56-46 at the break. The Timberwolves stretched the lead to 23 early in the fourth before the Grizzlies cut it to 97-90 with a 10-0 run. Jaden McDaniels scored 25 on 11-of-17 shooting, Ayo Dosunmu added 19 and Rudy Gobert had 11 rebounds for Minnesota, which was without Anthony Edwards. Cedric Coward led Memphis with 23 points and four steals.

games.headline: Wembanyama scores 50 with 18 boards in Spurs rout
games.story: Victor Wembanyama scored 50 points on 20-of-29 shooting in under 32 minutes, adding 18 rebounds, five blocks and four steals. New Orleans led 26-23 late in the first quarter before San Antonio went ahead for good, and the Spurs led 61-45 at halftime and by as many as 29 in the fourth. Stephon Castle added 19 points and De'Aaron Fox had 10 assists. Jeremiah Fears scored 29 for the Pelicans and Jordan Poole had 25.

games.headline: Keegan Murray tip-in lifts Kings past Celtics
games.story: Boston led 54-41 at halftime, but Sacramento outscored the Celtics 35-13 in the third quarter to take a 76-67 lead. The Celtics opened the fourth with 10 straight points, and the lead changed hands six times in the final 49 seconds. Keegan Murray tipped in a missed layup with five seconds left to answer Payton Pritchard's go-ahead jumper. Darius Acuff Jr. had 21 points and eight assists and Domantas Sabonis had 15 points and 17 rebounds, while Paul George scored 19 for Boston, which was without Jayson Tatum.
